strings.jp: 正義を信じて戦います!
strings.en:
I will fight, believing
in justice!

We shall not retreat.
Sally forth!

strings.jp: 勝利と未来をこの手に…!
strings.en:
Victory and the
future, in our hands...!

strings.jp: ワシの力を見せてやるぞぉ!
strings.en:
Time to show 'em
what I got!

Charge with all we
got, eh!

strings.jp:
我が黒薔薇の勝利のために
いざ、出撃!
strings.en:
For my Black Rose's
victory... forward!

Let's put some spirit
into it, shall we!

strings.jp: さて、どこへ行こっかな~?
次はどこへ進撃するか…?
さて、次なる目標の地は…?
strings.en:
Now, our next target
shall be...?
